detection.issues: Anonymous fallback IDs skip tracking logic but act as real objects.

tracking.issues: Tracking carryover uses max_age=25. This creates interactions using the last known position of an object even if it's no longer detected.

distance.issues: Metric outputs are generated even if the footprint is outside calibrated bounds.

ttc.issues: Calculated in pixel-space (ttc_image_proxy_sec). Falls back to arbitrary 99.90 when undefined.

event_generation.issues: Creates a new event per frame instead of grouping contiguous frames into a single Interaction Event.

id_handling.fallback_ids: Synthesized as frame_idx*1000 + i (>= 9000). Handled as independent objects per frame.
